evidence.quote: 2. Second Reading On The Following Moratoria Ordinances: (a) Ordinance 26-1050, Solar Moratorium ... (b) Ordinance 26-1051, BESS Moratorium ... (c) Ordinance 26-1052, Data Center Moratorium

evidence.title: Sumter County moves toward temporary pause on solar farms, data centers, battery sites
evidence.supports: Confirms the second-reading vote on all three 180-day ordinances and that one final reading remained before they could take effect.
evidence.quote: County Council approved the second reading of three proposed moratorium ordinances that would halt new applications for solar projects, battery energy storage facilities and data centers. ... The proposed moratoriums still need one final reading before they can take effect.

evidence.title: Sumter City-County Planning Commission staff report, OA-26-01, Data Centers (County)
evidence.supports: Shows the county was, by late August 2026, pursuing a separate permanent zoning-standards amendment for data centers (distinct from the 180-day moratorium track), consistent with the moratorium's final-adoption status remaining unresolved.
evidence.quote: OA-26-01, Data Centers (County) ... Request: Amend Articles 3, 4, 8, and 10 of the Sumter County Zoning & Development Standards Ordinance in order to adopt comprehensive standards for the establishment of data centers in Sumter County.

evidence.title: Data centers prompt call for moratorium in Beaufort County
evidence.supports: A September-dated statewide roundup lists Sumter County under 6-month moratoriums as "Proposed" rather than adopted, corroborating that final adoption of the 180-day ordinances was not confirmed.
evidence.quote: 6-month moratoriums * Chesterfield County: Adopted June 1. * Colleton County: Adopted July 6. * Chester County: Adopted July 16. * Orangeburg County. Proposed. * Clarendon County: Proposed. * Sumter County: Proposed.

new_candidates.notes: Genuinely could not resolve whether the 180-day moratorium ordinances (26-1050/1051/1052) received final (third-reading) adoption despite an extensive search of sumtercountysc.gov (Agendas/Minutes and Codified Ordinances pages are JS-rendered and did not yield a usable listing even in browser mode) and multiple news searches through 2026-09-23; enacted_status set to pending and confidence kept at 0.5 to reflect this. A coordinator following up should check the county's Codified Ordinances page directly (requires JS rendering) or call the Clerk to Council for the third-reading date.
